title: Add optional id to VtcStreamEnable for RequestError correlation
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Add optional id to VtcStreamEnable for RequestError correlation
Spec (81de006): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md L172-174: "**`id`** (String, optional): A client-specified identifier for this message. A `RequestError` caused by this message carries this value as its `requestId` ({{RFC8887}} Section 4.3.4)."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/stream.rs:44-59; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/ephemeral.rs:83-92
Now: VtcStreamEnable has no typed id. A client-sent id survives only in `extra`. replace_with's error doc does not mention echoing requestId.
Change: Add `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub id: Option<String>` to VtcStreamEnable. Document that the transport echoes it as requestId on the RequestError from replace_with.
Verifier correction: Add the typed optional `id` field as stated. Priority could reasonably be 3, since `extra` already preserves the value and no transport consumes it yet.
